evidence.field: sources/baxter-sagart/baxtersagart.tsv, 示 and 視 entries
evidence.text: In Baxter–Sagart 2014, 示’s ‘show’ reading is MC zyijH, OC *s-gijʔ-s; 視’s ‘look, see’ reading is MC dzyijH, OC *gijʔ-s, alongside 視 MC dzyijX, OC *gijʔ. The two 去聲 forms share the rhyme and differ by reconstructed *s-. This is compatible with the phonetic analysis but does not establish the graphic role. The supplied local notation is retained; the authors’ PDF search result independently displayed 示, but opening that PDF failed with 502.
evidence.title: Baxter-Sagart Old Chinese reconstruction, version 1.1 (2014)

evidence.source: Taiwan Ministry of Education, Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants
evidence.field: 說明; 說文釋形; 字樣說明; 釋義
evidence.text: The entry records the received Shuowen wording 瞻也。从見、示 and Duan Yucai’s explicit analysis 从見，示聲. It says the graph is filed under 見 because 見 carries the principal meaning. It lists senses including looking, observing, treating as, eyesight, caring for, administering, comparing, imitating, and a use通「示」, with classical citations. These entries do not establish a chronology or derivational path among those senses.
evidence.title: [A03769] 視 - Ministry of Education Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants

evidence.source: 裘錫圭, Fudan University Center for Excavated Texts and Paleography
evidence.field: 甲骨文中的見與視; article discussion and dated inscription contexts
evidence.text: 裘錫圭 argues that Shang oracle-bone forms with a seated human below 目 are 見, while those with a standing human are 視, drawing on their different contexts and the Guodian Chu slips’ contrasting forms. He reports an earlier proposal that the standing-figure form was 望 and argues against it. His article cites Shang contexts such as 視師 and 視方, and discusses Western Zhou bronze forms. The proposed distinction is a scholarly paleographic interpretation; the article does not supply an absolute date for a specific oracle-bone token.
evidence.title: 裘錫圭：甲骨文中的見與視

evidence.text: The file page describes 視-oracle.svg as a modern Inkscape vector in oracle-script style and cites a J20963 image on hanziyuan.net. It is a redraw, not an artifact photograph. The file’s provenance and stated reuse terms do not settle the paleographic reading; the inspected Fudan analysis supplies the interpretive context.

search_audit.query: 視 oracle bone 望 裘錫圭 seated standing figure 見; 視 示聲 見 段玉裁 說文 字形演變
search_audit.outcome: Inspected the Fudan paleographic article, Taiwan MOE dictionary entry, and file description pages for the three glyph leads. The evidence supports the article’s disputed early pictographic reading and the traditional dictionary’s received-form semantic/phonetic account; the early reading remains an interpretation.

gaps: Official Unicode character-specific Unihan records for 示, 視 and 视 were not accessible. The supplied local rows establish the data used in this comparison, but the external click-through pages could not be verified.

The Baxter–Sagart PDF was not readable in this session. Its search result exposed 示’s entry; the supplied local table rows provide the exact comparison for both 示 and 視. This pronunciation comparison is compatible with, but cannot prove, the phonetic-component analysis.

The source page for 視-seal.svg returned an internal error, so that local candidate was not verified or recommended. The accessible 示 and 見 seal-style file pages are modern graphic resources and do not independently establish component history.
The exact date of any individual Shang oracle-bone token remains unresolved in the inspected scholarship; later dictionary sense lists do not establish chronology among the semantic extensions.
